The '''Doornik-1142 system''', located on the edge of the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]],<ref name="CSWE-Doornik-1142" /> contained the [[Brown dwarf/Legends|brown dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Doornik-1142/Legends|Doornik-1142]] and four [[Gas giant/Legends|gaseous planets]].

The ''[[Astrolabe]]'' was destroyed by the [[Yevetha]] [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] ''[[Purity]]'' in-system.
